threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Peers earn a better ROE - the competitive position looks weaker.
A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management referred to a challenging market environment during the year.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Despite a challenging market environment, we recorded a significant improvement in revenue compared to the previous year, driven by strong performance across key business segments and sustained customer demand." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S7/W23/O24/T13), led by 'Management expressed hope to achieve better results in the next financial year', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
